description: Checks a public small-business website with Sitecomb's digital audit. It returns a score out of 100 and the most important problems (up to three). Each comes with a line on why it matters. Use it when someone asks whether their website is any good, or what is wrong with it. Also use it for "why isn't my site bringing in customers?" or a request to check or audit a website. It looks at six areas: security, privacy and legal notices, quality, phones, getting customers and AI visibility. A check loads the site the way a visitor's browser does and takes up to about a minute. It only finds problems; it never changes anything on the site. If the site is down or blocks automated checkers, it says it couldn't check and gives no score. Free checks are limited per person and per website each day.

url.description: The website address to check, for example https://yourbusiness.com or yourbusiness.com.

name: check_website
title: Check a website
